### Sketch Idea: "The Disgruntled Cottage Guard"
Place the English thatched hut in the midground with simple horizontal hatching and loose roof contours so it anchors the scene without getting cluttered. In the foreground, draw the figure leaning in the contrapposto pose against the hut's rustic wooden doorframe or fence post. Instead of a neutral face, adapt the cat's grumpy, squinting glare—heavy brows pressed down, flat skeptical mouth, and arms crossed or propped impatiently on the hips—as if they've just stepped outside their 16th-century cottage on a dreary morning to find a stray cat making the exact same grumpy face right at their feet.
